text:
Maya Sharma: Quick q — planning to enable `capacity.burst_override` for a short canary today 10:00-14:00 PST. Will touch queueing + max-concurrency guardrails. Any red flags?

AJ Chen: Who's owning the flip and watch? Need the exact audience list to validate targeting.

Maya Sharma: @AJ Chen I'll own the flip. Audience = canary-service-a, internal-qa. low-volume traffic only.

Sasha Ivanov: Can you paste the flag payload you're going to use? want to sanity-check limits.

Maya Sharma: sure — planned config: 
```json
{
  "flag": "capacity.burst_override",
  "state": "on",
  "audience": ["canary-service-a", "internal-qa"],
  "max_concurrency": 80,
  "burst_tokens": 2000,
  "queue_capacity": 500,
  "grace_window_seconds": 30
}
```

AJ Chen: Two quick asks: 1) cap max_concurrency at 80 is fine, but please set `grace_window_seconds` to 60 so transient spikes don't flip alerts. 2) Add `reject_after_queue_full=true` so we avoid unbounded latency.

Maya Sharma: updated — will run with grace_window_seconds=60 and reject_after_queue_full=true.

Priya Patel: I'll monitor dashboards (p95/p99, error_rate) and be ready to cut it if things regress. My thresholds: error_rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m OR p95 > 400ms for 3m -> rollback.

Sasha Ivanov: Add a rate of token burn monitor too — if burst token consumption > 60% within 10m that's a smoke signal. Also ensure the canary routing still falls back to smaller model variant if capacity hits a hard limit.

AJ Chen: small checklist before flip: 
- confirm audience targeting (Maya)
- update guardrail flags (Maya)
- Priya monitoring + alerts oncall (Priya)
- create quick rollback flag (Maya)
- run synthetic canary (Sasha)

Maya Sharma: doing the flip at 10:15 PST, will run a 15m synthetic load first, then open to traffic. rollback flag will be `capacity.burst_override_revert` set to on to disable. Command I'll use: 
`rb-flags set capacity.burst_override --on --audience=canary-service-a,internal-qa --meta="run:10-15-quick"`

oncall-bot: NOTE: Scheduled check-in at 10:30 PST, will post reminder.

Priya Patel: I'll set alerts: 
- `infra.capacity.error_rate > 0.5%` (5m)
- `infra.latency.p95 > 400ms` (3m)
- `infra.burst_tokens.used_pct > 60` (10m)
I'll also DM whoever is on primary pager if any trigger fires.

Maya Sharma: thanks — will ping here when synthetic starts. planning runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/capacity-override (see rollback steps + SLAs).

Sasha Ivanov: one more: re-check the canary scaling policy; don't allow autoscale to exceed dedicated pool capacity during the test. would hate for this to trigger cross-customer impact.

Maya Sharma: good call — locking autoscale max to dedicated-pool-1 for the window.

AJ Chen: ack. If anyone sees tail latencies rising or OOMs — flip `capacity.burst_override_revert` and notify infra-sre.

Priya Patel: I'll post a short summary after 30m with numbers.

Maya Sharma: synthetic started at 10:15. will report back in ~20m. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: REMINDER: Synthetic canary check in 20m (10:35 PST).
